metadata.description: Formal security audit findings for checklist items batch 2
metadata.analysis_method: 5-phase attack vector analysis with counterexample construction

input_validation_bypass.finding: ExecutableDataToBlock (beacon/engine/types.go) validates all payload fields before block conversion. Invalid payloads rejected at api.go:758.

state_transition_violation.finding: Payload-to-block conversion preserves data integrity. Block hash computed and compared against declared hash.

resource_exhaustion.finding: newPayloadLock serializes NewPayload calls to prevent resource exhaustion from concurrent payloads.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Errors from ExecutableDataToBlock return INVALID status via api.invalid() at line 788.

race_conditions.finding: newPayloadLock at line 754-755 prevents race conditions during payload processing.

guard_evaluation.rationale: All execution payload fields validated; structural integrity verified via hash comparison; concurrency controlled via mutex.

audit_findings.notes: @audit-ok annotation at api.go:644 confirms prior review.

input_validation_bypass.finding: StateDB tracks state changes during transaction processing. ProcessResult accumulates receipts and logs.

state_transition_violation.finding: state_processor.go:71-150 processes all transactions sequentially, maintaining state integrity via StateDB.

resource_exhaustion.finding: GasPool limits gas consumption per block. Transaction execution bounded by gas limits.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Errors during transaction processing return immediately with error, preventing partial state commits.

race_conditions.finding: Block processing is single-threaded per block. StateDB not accessed concurrently.

guard_evaluation.rationale: State changes tracked via StateDB, errors abort processing, atomic state commitment.

audit_findings.notes: Merkle Patricia Trie provides cryptographic commitment to state.

input_validation_bypass.finding: GetBlobsV1/V2 validate hash count limits (128 max) and version compatibility.

state_transition_violation.finding: Blob retrieval is read-only; no state modifications occur.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Request size limited to 128 blobs. TooLargeRequest error returned if exceeded.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Missing blobs return null entries or empty response per spec compliance.

race_conditions.finding: BlobTxPool accessed via thread-safe GetBlobs method.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Request size limited, fork validated, missing blob handling per Engine API spec.

audit_findings.notes: KZG commitments provide cryptographic blob verification.

input_validation_bypass.finding: Transaction validation in core/txpool/validation.go validates all tx types before pool admission.

state_transition_violation.finding: Invalid transactions rejected before affecting state.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Transaction size limits enforced (MaxMessageSize, MaxInitCodeSize). Fee requirements for pool priority.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Validation errors return specific error codes allowing peer penalty.

race_conditions.finding: TxPool has internal locking for concurrent P2P access.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Multi-layer validation prevents DoS via invalid/oversized transactions.

audit_findings.notes: @audit-ok annotations at validation.go:62-69 confirm prior review.

input_validation_bypass.finding: Block validation occurs before peer propagation. Invalid blocks trigger peer penalties.

state_transition_violation.finding: Block insertion validates parent chain, state root, and transaction execution before acceptance.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Block gas limits enforced. Invalid block tracking prevents repeated processing.

faulty_error_handling.finding: setInvalidAncestor callback tracks bad blocks. checkInvalidAncestor rejects known-bad blocks.

race_conditions.finding: invalidLock protects invalid block tracking. chainmu protects chain operations.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Invalid blocks tracked and rejected, peers penalized for bad blocks.

audit_findings.notes: Invalid block hit eviction (128) prevents memory exhaustion.

input_validation_bypass.finding: NewEVMBlockContext at state_processor.go:98 creates context from validated header.

state_transition_violation.finding: EVM context contains block info (number, time, coinbase, baseFee) from header.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Block gas limit enforced via GasPool. EVM execution bounded by gas.

faulty_error_handling.finding: EVM execution errors propagate to block processing failure.

race_conditions.finding: EVM instance created per block, not shared between blocks.

guard_evaluation.rationale: EVM context derived from validated header, gas-bounded execution.

audit_findings.notes: EVM context immutable during block processing.

input_validation_bypass.finding: TransactionToMessage at state_processor.go:110 converts and validates transaction to Message.

state_transition_violation.finding: Message struct contains all tx fields. Signature recovery recovers sender address.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Message gas limit bounded by transaction gas limit, which is bounded by block gas.

faulty_error_handling.finding: TransactionToMessage error at line 111-112 returns error with tx index.

race_conditions.finding: Message created per transaction, not shared.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Transaction data converted to Message with signature verification.

audit_findings.notes: Sender address cryptographically recovered from signature.

input_validation_bypass.finding: EVM.create at vm/evm.go:476 validates depth, balance, nonce overflow before contract creation.

state_transition_violation.finding: Contract creation uses snapshot/revert pattern for atomic state changes.

resource_exhaustion.finding: CallCreateDepth limit (1024) prevents stack overflow. Gas metering prevents infinite loops.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Creation failures revert to snapshot and return error.

race_conditions.finding: Contract creation is synchronous within EVM execution context.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Multiple guard conditions prevent resource exhaustion and state corruption.

audit_findings.notes: EIP-3541/EIP-3860 limits enforced for initcode.

input_validation_bypass.finding: EVM.Call at vm/evm.go:243 validates depth and balance before call execution.

state_transition_violation.finding: Snapshot taken at line 259; reverted to on error at line 307.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Depth limit (1024) and gas metering prevent resource exhaustion.

faulty_error_handling.finding: All errors trigger snapshot revert, ensuring state isolation on failure.

race_conditions.finding: EVM calls are synchronous within execution context.

guard_evaluation.rationale: State isolation via snapshot/revert pattern, depth and balance validated.

audit_findings.notes: StaticCall additionally prevents state modifications via readOnly flag.

input_validation_bypass.finding: Sender recovered via types.Sender in TransactionToMessage. ECDSA signature verified.

state_transition_violation.finding: Invalid signatures fail recovery, returning error before state access.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Signature verification is O(1) complexity, not exploitable.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Signature recovery errors returned from TransactionToMessage.

race_conditions.finding: Signature verification is stateless and thread-safe.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Cryptographic signature verification ensures sender authenticity.

audit_findings.notes: ECDSA secp256k1 used for signature verification.

input_validation_bypass.finding: preCheck at state_transition.go:313-328 validates nonce against state.

state_transition_violation.finding: ErrNonceTooHigh/ErrNonceTooLow returned for nonce mismatch, preventing replay.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Nonce check is O(1) state lookup, not exploitable.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Nonce errors returned before gas purchase or execution.

race_conditions.finding: State nonce read during transaction processing, protected by block processing order.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Nonce validated against state, preventing replay and out-of-order execution.

audit_findings.notes: SkipNonceChecks only true for eth_call simulations, not real transactions.

input_validation_bypass.finding: buyGas at state_transition.go:266-308 validates balance for gas + value + blob fees.

state_transition_violation.finding: ErrInsufficientFunds returned before any state modification if balance insufficient.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Balance check prevents transactions that cannot pay for execution.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Balance errors returned from buyGas, propagated through preCheck.

race_conditions.finding: Balance checked and deducted atomically within single transaction processing.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Balance validated for gas purchase, blob fees, and value transfer.

audit_findings.notes: uint256 used for balance calculations to prevent overflow.

input_validation_bypass.finding: ForkchoiceStateV1 contains HeadBlockHash, FinalizedBlockHash, SafeBlockHash. Each validated before use.

state_transition_violation.finding: GetBlockByHash verifies blocks exist before setting head/finalized/safe.

resource_exhaustion.finding: forkchoiceLock serializes forkchoice updates, preventing concurrent updates.

faulty_error_handling.finding: STATUS_INVALID returned for missing/invalid blocks. STATUS_SYNCING for unknown blocks.

race_conditions.finding: forkchoiceLock mutex at api.go:247-248 prevents concurrent forkchoice updates.

guards_identified: Finalized block in canonical chain check (line 349)
Safe block in canonical chain check (line 363)
guard_evaluation.rationale: All forkchoice hashes validated before use, mutex prevents races.

audit_findings.notes: Engine API spec compliance verified.

input_validation_bypass.finding: PayloadAttributes validated per fork version (V1/V2/V3) before use.

state_transition_violation.finding: Invalid attributes return STATUS_INVALID before any payload building.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Payload building bounded by block gas limits and time constraints.

faulty_error_handling.finding: InvalidPayloadAttributes error returned for malformed attributes.

race_conditions.finding: Payload building serialized by forkchoiceLock.

guards_identified: Fork-specific validation (V1: no withdrawals, V2: withdrawals, V3: beacon root)
guard_evaluation.rationale: PayloadAttributes validated for fork compatibility before use.

audit_findings.notes: Each Engine API version has specific payload attribute requirements.

input_validation_bypass.finding: Block headers validated via consensus engine and HeaderChain before acceptance.

state_transition_violation.finding: Invalid headers rejected before block body processing.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Header validation is lightweight, preventing DoS via malformed headers.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Header validation errors propagate to block rejection.

race_conditions.finding: Header chain has internal consistency checks.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Headers validated before body processing, preventing resource waste.

audit_findings.notes: PoS consensus uses beacon chain for finality.

input_validation_bypass.finding: State root computed after transaction execution, compared against header state root.

state_transition_violation.finding: State root mismatch causes block rejection.

resource_exhaustion.finding: State root computation bounded by block gas limit.

faulty_error_handling.finding: State root mismatch returns error, block marked invalid.

race_conditions.finding: State root computed synchronously during block processing.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Merkle Patricia Trie provides cryptographic state commitment verification.

audit_findings.notes: State root is cryptographic commitment to all account state.

input_validation_bypass.finding: Transactions from pool already validated. Block transactions re-validated during execution.

state_transition_violation.finding: Transaction execution validates nonce, balance, and gas at execution time.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Pool limits and block gas limits prevent unbounded transaction inclusion.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Failed transactions return error, block rejected if any tx fails.

race_conditions.finding: Block building uses snapshot of pool state.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Double validation (pool + execution) ensures transaction validity.

audit_findings.notes: Transactions validated at pool entry and again during execution.

input_validation_bypass.finding: ExecutableDataToBlock at api.go:758 validates all payload fields before block construction.

state_transition_violation.finding: Block hash computed and verified against declared hash.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Validation is bounded by payload size, which is limited by block gas.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Validation errors return INVALID status with detailed logging.

race_conditions.finding: newPayloadLock serializes payload validation.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Comprehensive payload validation before block construction.

audit_findings.notes: INVALID_BLOCK_HASH returned for hash mismatch.

input_validation_bypass.finding: getPayload at api.go:503 validates PayloadID version compatibility before retrieval.

state_transition_violation.finding: Payload retrieval is read-only, no state changes.

resource_exhaustion.finding: localBlocks cache bounded; payloads cleaned after retrieval.

faulty_error_handling.finding: UnknownPayload returned for invalid/expired PayloadIDs.

race_conditions.finding: localBlocks has thread-safe access.

guard_evaluation.rationale: PayloadID validated for version and fork compatibility.

audit_findings.notes: PayloadID encodes version information for validation.

input_validation_bypass.finding: Block validation includes state root verification after transaction execution.

state_transition_violation.finding: State committed only after all validations pass.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Block gas limit bounds execution cost.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Validation failures prevent state commit, block rejected.

race_conditions.finding: Block processing is serialized, state commit atomic.

guard_evaluation.rationale: All block fields validated before state commitment.

audit_findings.notes: VALID status only after full block validation.

input_validation_bypass.finding: Atomic commit ensured by StateDB finalization after all transactions.

state_transition_violation.finding: Errors during execution trigger rollback; partial state not committed.

resource_exhaustion.finding: State changes bounded by block gas; commit is O(state changes).

faulty_error_handling.finding: preCheck/execution failures return error before state modification at block level.

race_conditions.finding: Block processing single-threaded; state commit protected by chainmu.

guard_evaluation.rationale: State changes atomic per transaction and per block.

audit_findings.notes: Rollback via snapshot on any execution failure.
